\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{شکار} (shekâr)}{شکار (shekâr)}]{\fa{شکار} (shekâr) — hunting; prey, game}

\label{lesson:FA-C471-shekar}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for to go for an outing, then the Persian for to stop for the night.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{شکار}}
\textbf{\fa{شکار}} (\emph{shekâr}) — \textquotedblleft{}hunting; prey, game\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{شکار} \fa{در} \fa{این} \fa{منطقه} \fa{ممنوع} \fa{است}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Shekâr dar in mantaqe mamnu' ast.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
Hunting is forbidden in this area.
\end{quote}

A hunter is a \emph{shekârchi}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\emph{shekâr} is a native word, which EtymDB lists with the senses 'hunting, game'; it is usually traced to Middle Persian \emph{škār}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}

  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{shekâr}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} a sentence of your own with \emph{shekâr}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Persian for to go for an outing, then the Persian for to stop for the night, then say \emph{shekâr} again
\end{itemize}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{ماهیگیری} (mâhigiri)}{ماهیگیری (mâhigiri)}]{\fa{ماهیگیری} (mâhigiri) — fishing}

\label{lesson:FA-C471-mahigiri}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for to stop for the night, then the Persian for hunting.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{ماهیگیری}}
\textbf{\fa{ماهیگیری}} (\emph{mâhigiri}) — \textquotedblleft{}fishing\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{پدرم} \fa{جمعه} \fa{ها} \fa{به} \fa{ماهیگیری} \fa{میرود}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Pedaram jom'e-hâ be mâhigiri miravad.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
My father goes fishing on Fridays.
\end{quote}

\emph{mâhi} 'fish' + \emph{gir} 'catching' + \emph{-i}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\emph{mâhigiri} is a native compound of \emph{mâhi} 'fish', from Middle Persian \emph{māhīg} (EtymDB), and \emph{gir}, the present stem of \emph{gereftan} 'to take', with the ending \emph{-i}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{ماهی} \fa{گرفتن} (mâhi gereftan)}{ماهی گرفتن (mâhi gereftan)}]{\fa{ماهی} \fa{گرفتن} (mâhi gereftan) — to fish, to catch fish}

\label{lesson:FA-C471-mahi-gereftan}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for hunting, then the Persian for fishing.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{ماهی} \fa{گرفتن}}
\textbf{\fa{ماهی} \fa{گرفتن}} (\emph{mâhi gereftan}) — \textquotedblleft{}to fish, to catch fish\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{کنار} \fa{دریاچه} \fa{ماهی} \fa{گرفتیم}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Kenâr-e daryâche mâhi gereftim.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
We fished by the lake.
\end{quote}

Present stem \emph{gir-}: \emph{mâhi migirim}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\emph{mâhi gereftan} is built from \emph{mâhi} 'fish', inherited from Middle Persian \emph{māhīg} (EtymDB), and the native verb \emph{gereftan} 'to take'.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{شکوفه} (shekufe)}{شکوفه (shekufe)}]{\fa{شکوفه} (shekufe) — a blossom}

\label{lesson:FA-C471-shekufe}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for fishing, then the Persian for to fish.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{شکوفه}}
\textbf{\fa{شکوفه}} (\emph{shekufe}) — \textquotedblleft{}a blossom\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{در} \fa{بهار} \fa{درختهای} \fa{سیب} \fa{پر} \fa{از} \fa{شکوفه} \fa{است}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Dar bahâr derakht-hâ-ye sib por az shekufe ast.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
In spring the apple trees are full of blossom.
\end{quote}

Built on the stem of \emph{shekoftan} 'to bloom'.

\begin{cousinweb}
\emph{shekufe} is a native word built on the stem of \emph{shekoftan} 'to bloom, to open'. EtymDB does not list it.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{شکفتن} (shekoftan)}{شکفتن (shekoftan)}]{\fa{شکفتن} (shekoftan) — to bloom, to open (of a flower)}

\label{lesson:FA-C471-shekoftan}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for to fish, then the Persian for a blossom.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{شکفتن}}
\textbf{\fa{شکفتن}} (\emph{shekoftan}) — \textquotedblleft{}to bloom, to open (of a flower)\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{گلهای} \fa{حیاط} \fa{امروز} \fa{صبح} \fa{شکفتند}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Gol-hâ-ye hayât emruz sobh shekoftand.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The flowers in the courtyard opened this morning.
\end{quote}

Present stem \emph{shekof-}: \emph{mishekofad}. A smiling face is also said to \emph{shekoftan}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\emph{shekoftan} is a native verb, usually traced to Middle Persian \emph{škuftan} 'to bloom, to burst open'. EtymDB does not list it.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}
